Package it.polimi.ingsw.am43.model.cards

package it.polimi.ingsw.am43.model.cards
  • Class
    Description
    Artist
    Character card that applies the artist-specific tribe entrance effect.
    Builder
    Character card that contributes a building discount and end-game prestige points.
    Building
    Base class for every building card.
    Card
    Abstract class representing a generic card within the game.
    CharacterCard
    Base class for tribe cards that represent characters.
    Event
    Base class for every event card.
    EventBuilding
    Base class for buildings that react to events.
    EventEffect<T extends Event>
    Strategy describing how an event building reacts to a given event type.
    EventEffect.BonusHuntEvent
    Effect that grants prestige points and food equal to the player's number of hunters.
    EventEffect.BonusPaintingEvent
    Effect that grants food equal to the player's number of artists.
    EventEffect.DoubleWinInRitualEvent
    Effect that doubles the ritual reward (era × 5 prestige points) for a winning player.
    EventEffect.NoLossInRitualEvent
    Effect that cancels the ritual malus for a losing player.
    FinalBuilding
    A building whose effect is applied once, at the end of the game, according to the FinalEffect strategy it carries.
    FinalEffect
    Strategy describing the end-game scoring effect of a FinalBuilding.
    FinalEffect.FinalBonusPrestigePoints
    Grants a flat bonus of 25 prestige points.
    FinalEffect.FinalDoubleBuilderPrestigePoints
    Grants prestige points equal to the total prestige points of the player's builders.
    FinalEffect.FinalPrestigePointsByCharacterType
    Grants prestige points proportional to how many characters of a given type the player owns.
    FinalEffect.FinalPrestigePointsPerSet
    Grants 6 prestige points for each complete set of characters the player owns.
    Gatherer
    Character card that increases the player's sustenance discount during sustenance events when added to a tribe.
    Hunter
    Character card that can grant food when it enters a player's tribe.
    HuntEvent
    Hunt event: rewards each player with food and prestige points based on the number of hunters in their tribe.
    HuntEventBuilding
    Event building that reacts to a HuntEvent according to the EventEffect it carries.
    Inventor
    Character card identified by an inventor symbol.
    PaintingEvent
    Painting event: rewards players whose number of artists reaches the era threshold and penalizes those who fall short.
    PaintingEventBuilding
    Event building that reacts to a PaintingEvent according to the EventEffect it carries.
    RitualEvent
    Ritual event: the players with the fewest shaman stars suffer a malus, while those with the most gain extra prestige points.
    RitualEventBuilding
    Event building that reacts to a RitualEvent according to the EventEffect it carries.
    Shaman
    Character card that contributes shaman stars when added to a player's tribe.
    SustenanceEvent
    Sustenance event: each player must spend food equal to their tribe size (less any discount); players who cannot pay lose prestige points instead.
    SustenanceEventBuilding
    Event building that reacts to a SustenanceEvent according to the EventEffect it carries.
    TimedBuilding
    A building whose effect is triggered at specific moments of a round, according to the TimedEffect strategy it carries.
    TimedEffect
    Strategy describing the round-time effect of a TimedBuilding.
    TimedEffect.BonusPickCard
    Grants an additional draw action from the top row at the end of a round when the order queue is full.
    TimedEffect.BonusTurnFood
    Grants one extra food during action resolution when the current player acts while a food bonus is available and the order queue is not full.
    TribeBonus
    Strategy describing the recurring bonus granted by a TribeBuilding.
    TribeBonus.BonusShamanStars
    Grants 3 shaman stars, but only from the second time it is evaluated onwards.
    TribeBonus.FoodOnInventorSymbolPair
    Grants food equal to 3 times the number of inventor symbol pairs.
    TribeBonus.FoodOnSet
    Grants food equal to 5 times the number of complete character sets.
    TribeBonus.SustenanceDiscountByCharacterType
    Grants a sustenance discount based on the number of a given character type.
    TribeBuilding
    A building that grants a recurring TribeBonus.
    TribeCard
    Base class for the cards a player can pick into their tribe (characters and buildings).
